title: Position of Parts of Speech (Ques. No. 51-100)
subtopic: Position of Parts of Speech (236 Marks)

questions.question: He was a rather <u>disagreeable</u> man.[]
questions.explanation:
man = noun
আগে বসে describe করছে → Adjective

questions.question: <u>Still</u> waters run deep.[]
questions.explanation:
waters = noun
still তার আগে → Adjective

questions.question: My mother made my tea <u>hot</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
tea = noun
hot = tea এর অবস্থা
 object complement → Adjective

questions.question: Give me the <u>white</u> coloured dress.[]
questions.explanation:
dress = noun
 আগে বসে describe → Adjective

questions.question: What is <u>all</u> this noise ?[]
questions.explanation:
noise = noun
all noun কে সীমাবদ্ধ করছে → Adjective

questions.question: <u>Few</u> students come to school today.[]
questions.explanation:
students = noun
few পরিমাণ বোঝাচ্ছে → Adjective

questions.question:
All men must die. Here 'all' is used as ---
He gave me some books. Here 'some' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
পরে noun আছে → Adjective
 মনে রাখো:
All/some একা থাকলে Pronoun
All/some + noun হলে Adjective

questions.question: You can buy a ball pen for less than <u>five</u> taka. Here 'five' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
Number + noun
 সংখ্যা সবসময় Adjective

questions.question: There is <u>little</u> water in the pot.[]
questions.explanation:
পরে noun আছে
 little = পরিমাণ
 Adjective

questions.question:
We came to an <u>abandoned</u> house.
We went on a <u>painstaking</u> exploration.[]
questions.explanation:
noun এর আগে বসে
 describe করছে-
Adjective

questions.question: Tareq was a <u>bright</u> student.[]
questions.explanation:
student = noun
 আগে বসে describe
 Adjective

questions.question:
Are you an early riser ? Here 'riser' is -----
The <u>sealed</u> envelope contains OMR sheets.[]
questions.explanation:
early-adj এর পর noun 
er দিয়ে শেষ = সাধারণত noun
 envelope = noun
sealed আগে বসে → Adjective

questions.question:
A <u>summary</u> trial of criminals cannot be accepted in a civilized society.
Our team will get an advantage of the <u>home</u> ground.
He is an <u>honorary</u> professor of the Department of Law.
The lawyer filed a <u>review</u> petition.[]
questions.explanation:
(summary trial, home ground, honorary professor, review petition)
 চারটাতেই pattern:
(word + noun)
 সবগুলো noun কে describe করছে
 তাই Adjective

questions.question: We have a legendary past to be proud of. Here 'legendary' belongs to ---[]
questions.explanation:
past = noun
 আগে বসে → Adjective

questions.question: Kamal is the <u>most intelligent</u> boy in the class.[]
questions.explanation:
intelligent = boy কে describe করে
So, adj

questions.question: The word 'calling' in the sentence, 'The calling bell is out of order', functions as ---[]
questions.explanation:
এখানে calling শব্দটি bell-কে বর্ণনা করছে (কোন bell? → calling bell)।
যে শব্দ noun-কে describe করে → adjective।

questions.question: The <u>lone</u> and <u>level</u> sands stretch far away.[]
questions.explanation:
lone → sands-কে describe করছে
level → sands-কে describe করছে
দুটোই noun-কে describe করছে।

questions.question: <u>Sweet</u> are the uses of adversity.[]
questions.explanation:
এখানে sweet → uses-এর quality বোঝাচ্ছে।
মানে adversity-এর uses sweet।
Structure একটু উল্টানো, কিন্তু কাজটা adjective-এর।

questions.question:
Examinations are <u>frightening</u>.
The journey was <u>pleasant</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
frightening → examinations-এর অবস্থা/quality
pleasant → journey-এর quality
দুটোই predicate adjective।

questions.question:
He was <u>forbidden</u> to enter the room without his mother's permission.
The plank is <u>thick</u>.
The boy is <u>meritorious</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
forbidden → he-এর অবস্থা বোঝাচ্ছে
thick → plank-এর quality
meritorious → boy-এর quality
সবগুলোই adjective।

questions.question: The college teacher is <u>popular</u> among his students.[]
questions.explanation: popular → teacher-এর quality বোঝাচ্ছে।

questions.question: The man is <u>afraid</u> of the dog.[]
questions.explanation: afraid → man-এর condition/quality।

questions.question: It is <u>wrong</u> to <u>wrong</u> anyone.[]
questions.explanation:
প্রথম wrong → adjective (ভুল)
দ্বিতীয় wrong → verb (কারও প্রতি অন্যায় করা) to এরপর verb বসে।

questions.question: We felt very <u>tired</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
tired → we-এর condition
very → tired-কে modify করছে

questions.question: Rozina looks <u>amazed</u> after knowing her HSC result.[]
questions.explanation: amazed → Rozina-এর feeling

questions.question: He complained that the food tasted -----.[]
questions.explanation: Taste, smell, look, feel, seem → এর পরে Adjective বসে।

questions.question: The young man seems very -----.[]
questions.explanation:
seem → linking verb
এর পরে Adjective

questions.question: The roses in our garden smell really ----- this year.[]
questions.explanation:
smell → linking verb
এর পরে Adjective

questions.question: Depression is often <u>hereditary</u>. The underlined word is a/an ---[]
questions.explanation:
hereditary → depression-এর nature বোঝাচ্ছে
ry-suffix

questions.question:
The house is quite <u>near</u>.
Good computers are getting quite <u>cheaper</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
near → adjective
cheaper → adjective (comparative

questions.question: This is a book of the <u>English</u> language.[]
questions.explanation: এখানে English → language-কে describe করছে।

questions.question: He gave me a beautiful <u>diamond</u> ring.[]
questions.explanation:
beautiful → adjective
diamond → ring-কে describe করছে (noun কিন্তু adjective হিসেবে ব্যবহার)

questions.question: Bangladesh team scores 250 runs. In the sentence 'Bangladesh' is used as -----[]
questions.explanation: এখানে Bangladesh → team-কে describe করছে।

questions.question: She is a <u>village</u> girl.[]
questions.explanation: village → girl-কে describe করছে।

questions.question: I am a <u>university</u> student.[]
questions.explanation: university → student-কে describe করছে।

questions.question: The manufacturer should fix the  <u>market</u> price of the product.[]
questions.explanation: market → price-কে describe করছে।

questions.question: The <u>university</u> library is very rich.[]
questions.explanation: Noun + Noun → প্রথম noun adjective-এর মতো কাজ করে

questions.question: He was my <u>college</u> teacher.[]
questions.explanation: college → teacher-কে describe করছে।

questions.question: <u>Which</u> book do you want ?[]
questions.explanation:
Which → book-কে determine করছে।
এটা Interrogative adjective।

questions.question: He <u>fathered</u> the plan.[]
questions.explanation:
fathered → কাজ বোঝাচ্ছে (verb)
মানে: initiate / create।
Subject এরপর বসে verb

questions.question:
Muslims <u>fast</u> during Ramadan. Here 'fast' is ---
They glorify their success. Here 'glorify' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
fast / glorify → Verb
Trick: Subject + action → Verb
Muslims fast, They glorify

questions.question:
You should <u>dress</u> for cold weather today.
Boys <u>long</u> for holidays.
The war <u>lasted</u> long.[]
questions.explanation:
dress / long / lasted → Verb
Trick: Subject এর পরে কাজ হলে → Verb

questions.question:
He <u>penned</u> many popular novels.
He <u>penned</u> a good story last year.[]
questions.explanation:
penned → Verb
Trick: noun → action meaning হলে Verb
pen (noun) → penned (write)

questions.question:
The girls <u>water</u> the plants.
I <u>water</u> the plants.
I <u>water</u> the garden.[]
questions.explanation:
water → Verb
Trick: object এর আগে/Sub এর পরে action → Verb
water the plants

questions.question:
<u>Water</u> the garden.
<u>Mind</u> your own business.[]
questions.explanation:
Water / Mind → Verb
Trick: Imperative sentence → Verb দিয়ে শুরু

questions.question: Let us <u>winter</u> in Malaysia.[]
questions.explanation:
winter → Verb
Trick: season → spend season → Verb
winter in Malaysia

questions.question: All that <u>glitters</u> is not gold.[]
questions.explanation:
Water / Mind → Verb
Trick: Imperative sentence → Verb দিয়ে শুরু

questions.question:
Try to <u>better</u> your condition.
Try to <u>better</u> your lot.[]
questions.explanation:
better → Verb
Trick: to + word → Verb
to better = improve

questions.question: To <u>err</u> is human.[]
questions.explanation:
to err → Verb
Trick: to + verb = infinitive

questions.question: The underlined word 'What to <u>object</u> to is my object of study' is[]
options: Both a verb and a noun
questions.explanation:
object → Verb
Trick: to object = verb (আপত্তি করা)
